card.name: First digit of multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token that begins or sits inside a larger number, such as the 0 in 10 or 100, or the 7 in 745, in ordinary web prose. Also fires once on the odd name piece 'lev' in a Latin taxonomy citation.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit in a number that continues with more digits, often a round number like 10 or 100.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a number where more digits are likely to follow.
